tools.name: search
tools.description: Use this when the user wants Catalan, Spanish, or Mediterranean recipes or cooking ideas: dishes, desserts, breads, sauces, preserves, drinks, or techniques. tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Use this to retrieve the complete recipe (ingredients with quantities, steps, tips, nutrition) for an id returned by `search`.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Use this to browse the recipe categories (main dishes, soups, desserts, breads, sauces and preserves, drinks...) with recipe counts, before searching.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Use this when you already know a recipe's slug and want structured JSON (ingredient quantities and units, steps, servings, nutrition) instead of prose, for example to scale quantities or build a shopping list.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
